question: Can frozen DINOv2 foreground feature averaging over the exact three-frame target masks provide a view-robust identity agreement signal that removes SceneNN geometry false matches without true-match loss?

independent_motivation.source_inference: DINOv2 exposes transferable patch features and instance retrieval ability; CUTE and NIDS-Net independently use foreground feature averaging rather than global CLS for object-centric instance similarity, with maximum similarity across multiple templates.

model.input: tight visible-target-mask envelope from each sealed RGB frame, square-padded with black; processor shortest edge 256 and center crop 224
model.foreground_pooling: resize the binary target mask to 256 square, center crop 224, average each 14x14 patch to a continuous foreground weight on the native 16x16 patch grid, weighted-average final patch tokens, then L2 normalize

matching.appearance_pair_score: maximum cosine over the exact 3 reference by 3 query FFA descriptors
matching.geometry_score: unchanged predecessor negative symmetric median registered surface distance
matching.zero_assignment: strict reciprocal row-and-column maxima independently for geometry and FFA appearance
matching.consensus: retain a pair only when identical in both reciprocal match sets; no score fusion or threshold

forbidden_after_freeze: switch to CLS, another DINO layer, another crop, another pooling rule, or another view aggregation
fine-tune the backbone or fit an adapter, threshold, margin, or geometry-appearance weight
change frames, masks, targets, scenarios, or predecessor geometry
drop a hard true pair or inspect scenario labels to select descriptors
promote this consumed-scene privileged-mask result to fresh or phone-side confirmation
claim_boundary: This is a posthoc mechanism Development test on a consumed SceneNN scene. Its target masks and poses are evaluator-authoritative and unavailable to deployment; DINOv2 is frozen and no labels are used for fitting. A pass would retain only a challenger for fresh evaluation. It is not door detection, aperture, named entrance, ownership, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, HANDOFF_READY, user benefit, deployment, or safety evidence.
